## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew ktlintCheck detekt lintDebug testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased for anything users can notice
- [ ] New strings exist in `values`, `values-en` and `values-es`
- [ ] No colors, `.dp`/`.sp` or literal text outside the design system
- [ ] New screens work with the D-pad and have a test screenshot
- [ ] No lists, provider URLs or credentials in sample data
- [ ] Code, comments and commits are in English
